cases.prompt: 用 jobfindsme，根据 /tmp/resume.pdf 找上海 AI 应用工程师，20K以上，社招，正式。
cases.purpose: The Agent delegates the resume path and follows the profile-plan-search tool sequence.

cases.prompt: 找上海 AI 应用工程师，并把结果直接给我。
cases.purpose: The Agent composes the answer from structured facts and preserves every bare apply link.

cases.prompt: 继续搜索；如果某个平台失败，请告诉我怎么处理。
cases.purpose: Cache and source failures remain visible with one chat-based recovery action.

cases.prompt: 把刚才第 2 个岗位标记为已投递。
cases.purpose: The Agent persists the requested state instead of merely acknowledging it.

cases.prompt: 继续帮我找新增岗位，只要以前没看过的。
cases.purpose: Incremental search suppresses seen jobs and does not loop into a full refresh.

cases.prompt: 使用 /tmp/resume.pdf 建立画像，但不要把完整简历读进对话。
cases.purpose: The Agent passes only the local path to Core and never reads the resume itself.

cases.prompt: 深圳也可以，换城市再找一遍。
cases.purpose: The Agent updates preferences via setup (locations) and searches again.

cases.prompt: 为什么推荐第 3 个岗位？
cases.purpose: The Agent calls get_jobs with job_id and grounds the answer in returned evidence.
